title: Babies Steve & Bernadette Playing Indoors, 1968 B&W Snapshot Photo
description: An intimate black-and-white domestic snapshot from June 1968 capturing two young babies, identified on the reverse as Steve and Bernadette, sitting together on a carpeted living room floor. The baby in the foreground wears a light plaid outfit and chews on a teething toy, while the infant behind wears a patterned footed pajama sleeper. An upholstered armchair and household furniture sit in the background.
